rows.requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals
rows.gate: G1 sample size and G2 skill above variance. One strategy passes every gate, and its bet count is below the singles threshold in data/gates.json.
rows.measured: 1 of 16 strategies pass; the passing strategy has 398 bets.
rows.clears: 500 singles bets (G1). The passing strategy is short by 102 bets.

rows.requirement: Run the strategy set as a leaderboard competition
rows.gate: A random-picks control on every leaderboard run. No random-picks control is computed. One always-favourite baseline is shared by all runs and is not a per-run control.
rows.measured: 0 of 16 runs carry a random-picks control. Shared always-favourite ROI -2.7%.
rows.clears: 16 of 16 runs carry a random-picks control.
rows.basis: Owner brief: control baseline (random picks; favourites only) on every leaderboard run.

rows.requirement: Provide rewards for the top performing strategies
rows.gate: Reward rules, funding and legality are undefined. The register cites Q-09 for this, but Q-09 in data/questions.json is 'Market scope'. Rewards are Q-07 there and Q-20 in data/audit/decision_questions.json.
rows.measured: 0 reward rules recorded. Open questions: Q-07 (data/questions.json) and Q-20 (decision_questions.json).
rows.clears: 1 owner-approved reward rule set, with legality checked, closing Q-07 / Q-20.

rows.requirement: Cover single bets, parlays and player-prop bet combinations
rows.gate: A parlay or prop combo may be ranked only with a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void and push rules (G7). Multiplying marginals is not allowed.
rows.measured: 1 joint-probability files in the repository, against 3 combo families under G7.
rows.clears: 3 of 3 families with a holdout-calibrated joint probability.
rows.basis: data/gates.json, G7 applies_to (cross-game parlay, same-game parlay, prop combo).

rows.requirement: Every strategy must pass validation gates before it is allowed to bet
rows.gate: The G1 sample threshold differs between registers, so the pass rule is not one rule. README.md and app/validation.html say 100. data/gates.json says 500.
rows.measured: README and app/validation.html: 100. data/gates.json: 500.
rows.clears: One G1 threshold in both registers (1 of 1 agreed).
rows.basis: README.md line 'G1 | Sample sufficiency | >= 100'; data/gates.json G1.

rows.requirement: Determine correlation values between the signals and markets we use
rows.gate: Correlations cover team-stat pairs only. No player-to-market pair has an official source, so the blocked pairs are not computed.
rows.measured: 988 official team-stat pairs (n = 32 each); 0 player-market pairs.
rows.clears: Player-market pairs with n_eff of at least 500 (the G1 props threshold).

rows.requirement: Remove luck from the equation; keep only selectively skill-based strategies
rows.gate: Luck removal has bootstrap and sign-flip tests. It has no game-cluster lower bound and no multiplicity adjustment, and no cluster file exists in the repository.
rows.measured: 0 cluster files. 14 of 2,232 results are officially verified.
rows.clears: 500 official settled singles bets (G1). Official settled today: 14.

rows.basis: Owner brief (Wednesday to kickoff, daily). The scheduled refresh (.github/workflows/data-refresh.yml) runs every 6 hours; its output is not retained as a series.

flags.title: G1 sample threshold conflicts between registers
flags.detail: README.md and app/validation.html say 100 settled out-of-sample bets. data/gates.json says 500 singles bets. The one strategy that passes every gate has 398 bets, which passes the first and fails the second.

flags.title: Reward-rule cross-reference points at the wrong question
flags.detail: The register row R-10 cites Q-09 for reward rules. In data/questions.json Q-09 is 'Market scope'. Rewards are Q-07 there, and Q-20 in data/audit/decision_questions.json.

flags.title: Headline model error does not match the model report
flags.detail: The landing page states a spread MAE of 10.42 for the model and 9.73 for the market. data/lab/lines/model_report.json publishes side MAE 10.741 (model) and 9.792 (market) over 3,165 games. The landing figures were not reproduced from data/lab/lines/fair_lines.csv under either sign convention. Published as found; the text was not changed.

flags.title: Results feed is one day behind official finals
flags.detail: On 2026-11-15 nfl.com shows the Patriots-Lions game (Munich) as Final, 10-35. The feed records it as scheduled, with no score, because it was built on 2026-11-14. 122 2026 rows are still 'scheduled'. There is no freshness alarm.

flags.title: Injury captures are overwritten, not retained
flags.detail: The scheduled refresh runs successfully, but data/injuries/injuries_2026_week10.csv has one git commit (observed 2026-11-15, git log). A series of dated captures does not exist, so the 'continuous' claim in R-15 cannot be checked back in time.

flags.title: Injury re-capture (PR #49, merged) disagrees with the published table
flags.detail: PR #49 (merged as 4f361c9) recorded 347 official rows on nfl.com/injuries and 345 published rows. Recounted this round from data/capture/2026_w10/official_nflcom_injuries_week10_transcription.psv and data/injuries/injuries_2026_week10.csv: 14 rows carry team code LAR in the capture and LA in the published file (a code difference, not a missing player); after that normalisation, 2 Ravens rows (Calais Campbell, Ronnie Stanley) are absent from the published table; 16 rows differ in at least one field (injuries, practice status or game status). The capture is a transcription by that session and was not re-read against the live page this round. The published table has not changed.

flags.detail: Nine rows were recorded as met and are partly met on the data: R-12 (threshold conflict), R-14 (no cluster bound), R-15 (one capture date, no retained series), R-16 (31 of 32 depth charts), R-17 (no snap counts or inactive lists), R-20 (open re-capture), R-46 (price pairs), R-47 (official rows) and R-49 (mirror market lines).
